props.Value: That depends. You buying something, or wasting my time?
So... another rookie finally crawls into the village. You've got that look already. Tired. Confused. Broke. Means you'll fit right in.
Someone's always going to want something done around here. Most traders or STALKERS you find around the zone might have a job for you.
Whatever keeps people alive another day. Ammo. Food. Meds. Firearms if you've got enough roubles.
Is there anything you need done?
Because the Zone always finds a way to bring you back.
How do I make money around here?
Rookie Village, right infront of the Cordon. First stop for rookies like you. People come here thinking they'll get rich. Most just end up feeding the dogs.
